lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 10-12 distinct vertical white line segments visible across the mid and posterior torso; spacing is wider in the anterior section (shoulder to mid-rib) and becomes increasingly dense and narrow toward the haunches.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: One Y-shaped topological bifurcation is visible in the fourth primary stripe from the shoulder, splitting near the mid-lateral line; a second merging point is visible where two thin lines converge at the dorsal boundary above the hindquarters.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Multiple abbreviated segments are present, including a short dashed line between the third and fourth full stripes and several terminal segments that cease 50% down the torso height.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: High-contrast grouping of approximately 8-12 circular white spots concentrated on the lower posterior haunch, specifically located superior to the hock joint and inferior to the primary vertical stripes.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two distinct horizontal alignments of spots are visible on the mid-thigh, forming a semi-linear geometric pattern parallel to the ventral line.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible white chevron pattern on the bridge of the snout and two distinct white spots located on the lower cheek area; white horizontal band present on the lower portion of the forelimbs.
